headline.purpose: Menu header language name, group headings.

caption.purpose: Descriptions under row titles, section labels, tags.

capsule-label.purpose: Layout code (EN/RU) in the menu bar capsule.

hero-word.purpose: Onboarding demo word under the glass strip.

shadows.name: strip-rim
shadows.purpose: Light edge on every glass strip. Dark: .5px rgba(255,255,255,.22), inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2).

shadows.name: strip-glow
shadows.purpose: Indigo under-glow beneath strips, thumbs and selected presets.

shadows.name: window
shadows.purpose: Floating windows. Dark: rgba(0,0,0,.75) / .35 / white .12 rim.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Menu, caret hint, dock tooltips. Dark: white .14 rim, black .7 / .3.

shadows.name: keycap-edge
shadows.purpose: Physical lower edge of a keycap only (2.5px on the big key).

materials.name: bar
materials.css: background: rgba(255,255,255,.40) (dark rgba(20,20,26,.40)); backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(1.8)

materials.name: window
materials.css: background: rgba(251,251,253,.80) (dark rgba(32,32,38,.80)); backdrop-filter: blur(50px) saturate(1.9)

materials.name: popover
materials.css: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.84), rgba(250,250,255,.70)) (dark rgba(48,48,58,.86) to rgba(36,36,44,.76)); backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(1.9)
materials.purpose: Menu popover; caret hint uses blur(20px) saturate(1.8).

materials.name: strip
materials.css: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.78), rgba(222,222,255,.50)) (dark rgba(255,255,255,.20) to rgba(140,138,255,.16)); backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.8)

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Switch knob (.4s), capsule press (.3s); segment thumb uses (.2,1.25,.3,1) at .5s. Only these three may overshoot.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Popovers, hint, sidebar selection, dock lift (.35 to .55s).

motion.name: ease-out-panel
motion.purpose: Window open, pane and step transitions, capsule label slide (.45 to .6s).

motion.name: strip-wipe
motion.purpose: Cover, retype, peel of the correction strip (.95s; 6s hero loop; capsule sheen .85s).

components.name: Menu Bar Capsule
components.description: Glass strip in the menu bar showing the current layout; springs on press.
components.css: .ds-capsule { height: 22px; min-width: 46px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; color: #4644D0; font: 800 11.5px/1 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.78), rgba(222,222,255,.50)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.95), inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(94,92,230,.10), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(94,92,230,.35), 0 3px 10px -3px rgba(94,92,230,.45); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.3,1); } .ds-capsule:active { transform: scale(.94); } .ds-capsule:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(94,92,230,.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid indigo pill with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 30px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 15px; background: #5E5CE6; color: #fff; font: 500 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(94,92,230,.45), inset 0 .5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35); transition: transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(94,92,230,.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral wash pill for non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 30px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 15px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.08); color: #1D1D1F; font: 500 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(94,92,230,.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #5E5CE6; transition: background .25s; } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3); transform: translateX(16px); transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.3,1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='false'] { background: rgba(0,0,0,.08); } .ds-switch[aria-checked='false']::after { transform: none; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(94,92,230,.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Wash track whose thumb is a glass strip.
components.css: .ds-seg { position: relative; display: inline-grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; padding: 2px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.045); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.08); font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-thumb { position: absolute; top: 2px; bottom: 2px; left: 2px; width: calc(50% - 2px); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(255,255,255,.76)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.95), inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(94,92,230,.10), 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(94,92,230,.45); transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.25,.3,1); } .ds-seg button { position: relative; border: 0; background: none; padding: 4px 12px; color: #66666C; } .ds-seg button.on { color: #1D1D1F; font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(94,92,230,.55); border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Settings Group
components.description: Inset grouped card with title/description rows and trailing controls.
components.css: .ds-group { border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.66); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.08); font: 13px/1.4 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 14px; min-height: 44px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08); } .ds-row small { display: block; color: #66666C; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 1px; }

components.name: Latest Fix Row
components.description: Menu list row for the most recent correction, rendered as a glass strip.
components.css: .ds-fix { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 10px; font: 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1D1D1F; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.78), rgba(222,222,255,.50)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.95), inset 0 -1px 1px rgba(94,92,230,.10), 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(94,92,230,.45); } .ds-from { color: #A1A1A8; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: rgba(94,92,230,.55); } .ds-when { margin-left: auto; color: #A1A1A8; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Timing Bar
components.description: Shift timing track: indigo zone counted, hatched zone not counted.
components.css: .ds-track { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 30px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.045); overflow: hidden; } .ds-zone { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 76.9%; background: rgba(94,92,230,.13); } .ds-late { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 76.9%; right: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,.08) 0 4px, transparent 4px 9px); } .ds-bar { position: absolute; top: 5px; bottom: 5px; left: 5px; width: 40%; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.78), rgba(222,222,255,.50)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.95), 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(94,92,230,.45); }

components.name: Keycap
components.description: Physical key with a lower edge; the big variant presses down and fills indigo.
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 26px; height: 24px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #1D1D1F; font: 600 12.5px/1 -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1.5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08), inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }

components.name: Caret Hint
components.description: Popover by the caret: struck-out original, new word, undo action.
components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 12px; border-radius: 13px; font: 12.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1D1D1F; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.84), rgba(250,250,255,.70)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.9), 0 24px 60px -18px rgba(30,25,90,.45), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.08); } .ds-hint .ds-from { color: #A1A1A8; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: rgba(94,92,230,.55); } .ds-act { padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(94,92,230,.13); color: #4644D0; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Every correction is a strip of frosted glass laid over a word, like correction tape: it wipes on, rests while the word is retyped, and peels off on Backspace. The interface is a native macOS 26 window system (translucent windows, SF Pro, system-style controls) in which that one object recurs everywhere a thing is chosen, fixed or measured.

The system is quiet. Windows are large, soft glass planes over a colored wallpaper; content sits in inset grouped rows. One indigo accent carries every active, selected and corrected state, so a viewer can find what changed by looking for indigo glass.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted strip surface (gradient + 0.5px light rim + indigo under-glow) as the single signature material.
One accent: indigo, with a lighter dark-mode value and a solid fill kept for white-on-accent.
Native structure: traffic lights, menu bar, grouped rows, sidebar selection, popovers, dock.
Hatched diagonal fill means time or zone that is not counted.
Springs only on switches, segment thumbs and the menu bar capsule; everything else eases out.
Light and dark are both first-class and follow the system by default.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the only accent hue. Warning amber and permission green are status colors, never decoration. Per-section sidebar icon tiles use macOS-style multi-hue gradients as a native System Settings idiom and do not extend to any other element.

rules.name: The White-on-Fill Rule
rules.body: White text sits only on Solid Indigo Fill (#5E5CE6). Text on translucent indigo or glass uses Indigo Ink.

rules.name: The No-Second-Face Rule
rules.body: One family. Emphasis is weight (400/600/700/800), never a different typeface.

rules.name: The Rim-and-Glow Rule
rules.body: Every raised glass surface carries both the light rim and a tinted (never black-only) under-glow. Grey drop shadows alone are wrong.

dos: Do express any new selected / corrected / measured state as a glass strip (gradient, .5px rim, indigo glow) before inventing another highlight.
Do use Solid Indigo Fill (#5E5CE6) for anything carrying white text, in both appearances; use Indigo Ink for text on glass.
Do ship every surface in light and dark with the paired values, and follow the system appearance by default.
Do reserve springs for switches, segment thumbs and the capsule; use ease-out for everything else.
Do use the hatch (135deg stripes) only for time or zones that are not counted.
Do honor reduced motion: collapse all durations to near zero.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, or use amber/green as decoration.
Don't use keyboard icons, flags or toggle grids as the brand device.
Don't put black-only drop shadows on glass or rely on solid 1px borders for grouping.
Don't bounce anything outside the three spring components.
Don't set essential information in Quiet Ink (#A1A1A8); it is for placeholders and struck-out originals.
